title: Optimum acceptance is at most one
statement: Let $n$, the proof length, and the query count be natural numbers, and let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean inputs of length $n$ and proofs of the stated length. Its maximum acceptance probability over all input words and proof words is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural-number input length, proof length, and query count
A Boolean PCPP system with those parameters
